name: json-streamer
description: Streaming JSON parser for large arrays or newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) payloads, emitting objects as they are parsed without loading the whole file into memory.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when parsing massive JSON arrays or lines of Newline-Delimited JSON (NDJSON/JSONL) records from HTTP responses or local logs without loading the full payload into memory.
